name: soap-tray
title: Soap tray
orientation: Flat side down on the bed. Walls are straight up, so it prints without supports.

length.rule: Long enough for a bar of soap
length.label: Length

width.rule: Wide enough for a bar of soap
width.label: Width

wall.rule: Four print lines: stiff, and no gaps between lines
wall.label: Wall

rib_height.rule: Holds the soap up out of the water
rib_height.label: Rib height

pitch.rule: Ribs this far apart: soap rests on several, water runs between
pitch.label: Rib spacing

slot.rule: Drain slots between the ribs, widened for how holes print small

margin.rule: Solid floor between the slots and the walls
